relations.subject: GONZÁLEZ DE LA CALLE, Pedro Urbano
relations.evidence: Son of Urbano González Serrano (1848–1904), professor of philosophy, and Petra de la Calle Corisco.

relations.subject: GONZÁLEZ DE LA CALLE, Pedro Urbano
relations.evidence: Studied philosophy and classics, also Sanskrit under Daza de Campos.
